$comment: How the master image is painted from real Earth data. Layers are painted in order, so a later one covers an earlier one: biomes first, then ice, then water. Every class name here must exist in palette.json. Run `npm run world:master --prefix frontend`.

layers.$comment: Land first, marked as land with no terrain decided. The two datasets disagree about where a coast is, so this leaves a thin fringe the build fills from the terrain behind it rather than guessing a single colour. It never survives into the finished image.
Earth's biomes. The mapping turns the dataset's own biome numbers into our classes.
Rivers are thinner than a pixel, so they are drawn as a line of a given width rather than filled.
